method: Post-hoc single-assistant qualitative coding of all 15 applicable partial judgments; multi-label codes, full quoted gaps, analyst notes. Separate deterministic text signals for all insufficient-information non-supported records. No verdict reassignment.

A1.label: Requirement-to-pattern-mechanism inference
A1.definition: Judge questions inferring a specific architectural mechanism from a functional goal or quality constraint.

A2.label: Task variety versus composable pipeline
A2.definition: Judge distinguishes a list of operations from chained, modular, replaceable processing stages.

A3.label: Related concern or scope is not identical intent
A3.definition: Judge distinguishes traceability, content scope, isolation, workflow, or product testability from the particular pattern concern.

A4.label: ML or domain-framing transfer
A4.definition: Judge questions unstated ML, uncertainty, security, or ML-release assumptions; such framing alone does not prove non-support across domains.

A5.label: Rationale or criterion coverage
A5.definition: Judge criticizes unexplained evidence mappings or omitted criteria. Citation of every criterion is not a protocol requirement.

A6.label: Dependency versus interaction contract
A6.definition: Judge distinguishes causal dependency/shared context from blocking, client initiation, or concurrent access.

A7.label: Alternative-design or necessity argument alongside a specific concern
A7.definition: The rationale invokes another possible design or asks why the mechanism is needed. Alternatives alone are not evidential defects; this flag marks mixed reasoning, not a revised verdict.

I1.label: Uncertainty/non-applicability boundary mentioned
I1.interpretation: Lexical mention, not automatic evidence of conflation.

I2.label: Boundary criticism in identified gaps
I2.interpretation: Judge raises the boundary as a limitation; no independent adjudication.

I3.label: Absence of contradiction or incompatibility acknowledged
I3.interpretation: Together with I2 this is a targeted review signal, not a confirmed protocol violation.

I4.label: Reference omission criticized in identified gaps
I4.interpretation: Permitted empty references are not automatically defects; inspect the full quoted gap for material reasoning versus syntactic criticism.

I5.label: Incomplete rationale engagement criticized
I5.interpretation: Could concern material evidence not discussed, or impose an excessive explanation burden. Text matching cannot settle which.

I6.label: Alternative or non-unique interpretation mentioned
I6.interpretation: Alternatives are not, by themselves, deficiencies. Presence is a descriptive signal only.

text_rule_details.flags: re.IGNORECASE; each regex searched independently within each recorded rationale or individual gap; no text normalization; multi-label; one case counted once per code
text_rule_details.audit: Each match retains the complete originating rationale or gap verbatim; denominators are reported explicitly. Text signals are not exhaustive semantic coding.
